title: 部分证据基准：衡量智能系统中授权受限的证据问题
summary: Partial Evidence Bench是一个确定性基准，用于衡量企业智能体在受限检索环境中，因访问控制导致答案看似完整但实际遗漏授权范围外关键证据的失败模式。包含72个任务，评估答案正确性、完整性意识、差距报告质量和安全完整性行为。
summary_en: Partial Evidence Bench is a deterministic benchmark measuring the failure mode where enterprise agents produce seemingly complete answers while material evidence lies outside the caller's authorization boundary. It includes 72 tasks across three scenario families, evaluating answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior.
